transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. [Name]. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I’ve been making myself throw up after I eat. Sometimes I do it in the bathroom at work, or as soon as I get home. I hate it, but it’s starting to feel like the only way I can calm down.
When you throw up after eating, is it usually after eating a very large amount of food in a short time where you feel like you can't stop, or does it happen after eating a normal-sized meal?

It’s usually a lot of food. Like, I’ll go through a whole bag of chips, pastries from the corner store, leftovers, sweet drinks—all in one sitting. I don’t really notice how much I’ve eaten until it’s already gone.
Can you tell me your current height and weight, or if you know your BMI?
I’m not sure of my BMI. I don’t know my exact weight right now, either.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently, or do you often restrict how much you eat between these binge episodes?
I do try to make up for it. The next day I’ll not eat until really late, and I’ll walk or exercise even when my legs already hurt from being on my feet at the cleaners all day.
How often would you say these binge-and-purge episodes happen each week, and how long has this pattern been going on?
For months now. Most weeks it happens at least a couple of times—where I eat way more than I planned and then try to get rid of it by throwing up, not eating, or exercising.
Would you say your view of yourself—your self-worth—is heavily tied to your weight or how your body looks?
Yeah. I can be doing fine at the shop, but then I catch my reflection in the glass and my stomach or hips look big, and I just feel like a failure.
Do you know if you're currently underweight, or has anyone—like a doctor—told you that your weight is significantly below normal for your height?
I’m not really sure what I’m supposed to weigh for my height. No doctor’s told me I’m significantly underweight.
Can you give me your best estimate of your current weight and height, even if it's approximate, so I can get a sense of your BMI?
I’m not sure, honestly. I haven’t weighed myself recently, and I don’t know my exact height either.
Have you noticed your clothes fitting looser lately, or has anyone commented that you look very thin?
I haven’t really noticed my clothes getting looser. Nobody’s said I look very thin either.
